title: To designate the Federal building and United States courthouse located at 719 Church Street in Nashville, Tennessee, as the "Fred D. Thompson Federal Building and United States Courthouse".
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The expanded summary of the House passed version is repeated here.)

(Sec. 1) This bill designates the federal building and U.S. courthouse located at 719 Church Street in Nashville, Tennessee, as the "Fred D. Thompson Federal Building and United States Courthouse."

summary.headline: A 2017 law renamed the federal building and courthouse at 719 Church Street in Nashville, Tennessee, after former senator Fred D. Thompson.
summary.what_it_does: The law gives the federal building and United States courthouse at 719 Church Street in Nashville, Tennessee, the official name "Fred D. Thompson Federal Building and United States Courthouse." It changes only the name of the building. It does not change how the building is used, who works there, or how courts operate in it.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was signed on June 6, 2017.
